llmnav-catalog/1 repository=relaydock catalog=relaydock.expert
Read semantic cards before opening source. Resolve current paths and signatures with llmnav query or show.

@relaydock.expert.lifecycle
role Define allowed consultation state transitions from context request through approval, execution, result, and terminal outcomes.
owns consultation state graph, consultation lifecycle events
excludes state persistence, worker lease claims
invariant Only declared state-event pairs can advance a consultation.

@relaydock.expert.application
role Compose expert consultation, ContextPack, and result stores while preserving atomic cross-aggregate creation and completion when supported.
owns expert application composition, cross-store fallback cleanup, attested result commit
excludes consultation transition policy, ContextPack file selection
invariant Durable stores use their atomic aggregate operations when available. Fallback writes compensate partial ContextPack or result persistence on later failure.

@relaydock.expert.openai-api
role Submit a redacted ContextPack to the OpenAI Responses API under explicit output and cost ceilings, then validate the structured expert result.
owns OpenAI expert request, expert cost preflight, structured result decoding
excludes ContextPack redaction, consultation state transitions
invariant A positive cost ceiling is enforced before network I/O using configured pricing. Provider responses are bounded and must validate against the result contract.

@relaydock.expert.web-handoff
role Issue expiring read tokens for browser handoff consultations and accept only validated structured results before expiry.
owns web handoff token lifecycle, handoff expiry, web result import
excludes browser automation, consultation persistence
invariant Only a digest of each read token is retained after issuance. Expired handoffs cannot resolve tokens or accept results.

@relaydock.expert.result-contract
role Normalize, validate, clone, and store expert result records behind process-local Store and RecordStore contracts.
owns expert result schema, result record normalization, process-local result storage
invariant Invalid results are rejected before an identifier is allocated or a record is stored. Stored and returned results are cloned so callers cannot mutate retained records through shared maps or slices.
risk concurrency
